description: Source code for a Kubernetes API server admission plugin related to policy validation and type checking, including classes and methods for schema resolution, type checking, and expression compilation.

classes.name: TypeChecker
classes.description: Main class for performing type checking on admission policies.

classes.name: TypeCheckingContext
classes.description: Holds context information for type checking, including GVKs, decl types, and variables.

classes.name: TypeCheckingResult
classes.description: Represents the result of a type check, including issues and errors.

classes.name: TypeCheckingResults
classes.description: A collection of multiple type checking results.

classes.name: typeOverwrite
classes.description: Helper struct for overriding object and parameter types during compilation.

classes.name: typeCheckingCompiler
classes.description: Wrapper for the CEL compiler used during type checking, with custom compile logic.

methods.name: Check
methods.description: Performs type checking on a given validating admission policy and returns warnings.

methods.name: CreateContext
methods.description: Creates a type checking context from a policy, resolving schemas and GVKs.

methods.name: compiler
methods.description: Builds a CEL compiler configured for type checking with specific type overrides.

methods.name: CheckExpression
methods.description: Type checks a single expression within a given context.

methods.name: declType
methods.description: Resolves and constructs a DeclType for a given GVK.

methods.name: paramsGVK
methods.description: Extracts the GVK for the policy parameters.

methods.name: typesToCheck
methods.description: Determines which GVKs need to be checked based on policy resource rules.

methods.name: sortGVKList
methods.description: Sorts a list of GVKs by group, version, and kind.

methods.name: tryRefreshRESTMapper
methods.description: Attempts to refresh the REST mapper if supported.
